requirements.text: While local development mode is active, when model updated event is received, the engineering model go shall validate architecture model before generation run is requested.
While model is valid, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall produce AsciiDoc architecture publication output without whitespace-only lines.
Where threat export is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall export threat dragon json artifact plus open threat model artifact.
Where structurizr export is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall export structurizr dsl artifact.
Where traceability export is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall produce trlc package and lobster trace report artifacts.

While mcp server is enabled, when mcp tool call is received and catalog references resolve successfully, the engineering model go shall return mcp tool result with schema version and structured error fields.
When mcp tool call is received, the engineering model go shall reject path arguments outside repository workspace boundary.
While ci validation mode is active, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall execute validation plus tests before artifact generated event is raised.
Where requirement trace is complete, when model updated event is received, the engineering model go shall infer traceability coverage from trace markers.
Where external schema dependencies are available, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall fail validation if schema checks do not match expected constraints.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall generate artifacts deterministically so that regeneration is reproducible.

Where traceability export is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall export an OSCAL aggregate profile plus SSP plus assessment plan plus assessment results plus POA&M artifacts when the corresponding compliance and remediation content is applicable.

Where architecture decision records are authored, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall publish architecture decision records document linked from AsciiDoc architecture publication output.
Where gemara export is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall render OpenSSF Gemara model artifacts.
Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall resolve the subsystem references declared by the parent system from local subdirectory paths.
Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall reject any subsystem reference that resolves outside the repository workspace boundary.
Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall reject a subsystem reference graph that contains a cycle.
Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall resolve cross-system references using subsystem-qualified identifiers.

Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall materialize parent-to-subsystem allocation traceability in the composed output without modifying any subsystem model.
Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall report each subsystem required interface that the parent system does not satisfy.
Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall reject an allocation that targets a subsystem identifier not published in the subsystem contract.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall flag any requirement that links to another requirement in the same document.
Where hardware interfaces are authored, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall render the hardware to software interface allocation view.
Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall produce a system requirement allocation matrix aggregated across the composed subsystems.

Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall render in the requirement view the delegation link from each delegated requirement to the specific subsystem requirement that satisfies it.

Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall resolve an external git subsystem reference by cloning the repository into the workspace .engmod cache.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall reject a code trace link that resolves to no requirement or model element.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall flag each requirement that is traced by neither code nor verification nor a downward delegation.

When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall export a machine-readable traceability matrix that links each requirement to its implementing code and verification and delegated subsystem requirement.
When requirements delta is received, the engineering model go shall strictly validate requirements delta schema plus stable identifier operation uniqueness.
While dry run mode is active, when requirements delta is received, the engineering model go shall validate candidate architecture model without modifying requirements document.
While model is valid, when requirements delta apply is requested, the engineering model go shall atomically replace requirements document.
When requirements delta is received, the engineering model go shall produce deterministic requirements change summary.
When model updated event is received, the engineering model go shall normalize architecture model plus requirements document into canonical semantic model.
Where sysml export is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall generate sysml v2 model artifact from canonical semantic model.
While ci validation mode is active, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall validate sysml v2 model artifact before artifact generated event is raised.
Where sysml export is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall validate canonical semantic model against sysml v2 metamodel.
While ci validation mode is active, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall reject incomplete sysml v2 metamodel coverage.
When generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall preserve the deterministic native sysml v2 source through project interchange round trip.

Where naf profile authoring is enabled, when model updated event is received, the engineering model go shall validate naf v4.1 stakeholder plus concern plus viewpoint metadata against canonical model references.
Where naf export is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall generate deterministic naf v4.1 architecture document from referenced canonical model views.

While ci validation mode is active, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall reject unsupported naf version plus unknown viewpoint code plus dangling profile reference before artifact generated event is raised.

When model updated event is received, the engineering model go shall load schema version 2 engmod manifest plus catalog plus requirements plus architecture plus behavior plus assurance plus compliance plus views plus decisions documents into one canonical semantic model.
While mcp server is enabled, when mcp tool call is received and catalog references resolve successfully, the engineering model go shall return schema version 2 model authoring contract.

While ci validation mode is active, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall reject model input that violates the schema version 2 manifest or any referenced domain document contract before artifact generated event is raised.
Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall resolve each exact CUE module version from the OCI registry configured by CUE_REGISTRY.

Where a model workspace replacement is declared, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall resolve the matching manifest dependency from the replacement repository without changing module identity or selected publications.

While ci validation mode is active, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall reject invalid manifest dependency plus publication plus workspace replacement plus qualified reference declarations.

When example validation is requested, the engineering model go shall validate a schema version 2 company portfolio composed from multiple product systems that reuse published hardware plus software plus security plus compliance facets across repository boundaries.

Where system composition is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall import only explicitly selected dependency publications with qualified identity plus source provenance.

Where six-view example output is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall generate deterministic use-case plus logical plus process plus physical plus implementation plus deployment view artifacts and native SysML from one schema version 2 YAML bundle.

Where do-178c dal c readiness output is enabled, when model updated event is received, the engineering model go shall load a strict aviation assurance profile plus lifecycle data plus verification evidence plus configuration baselines plus tool assessments plus structural coverage summaries.

Where do-178c dal c readiness output is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall reject incomplete or inconsistent requirement classification plus derived requirement disposition plus verification chain plus independence plus baseline plus structural coverage plus tool assessment evidence.

Where do-178c dal c readiness output is enabled, when generation run is requested, the engineering model go shall generate deterministic draft lifecycle data index plus objective evidence matrix plus requirements trace matrix plus verification summary plus structural coverage summary plus tool assessment register plus configuration index plus open gap report plus software accomplishment summary.

When example validation is requested, the engineering model go shall validate a schema version 2 DAL C flight control software example with placeholder planning plus requirements plus design plus code plus verification plus coverage plus configuration plus quality assurance plus certification liaison evidence.
